name: Low Vision Lifeline
description: Low vision assessment, magnification, field enhancement, eccentric viewing, assistive technology, driving cessation counseling, and psychosocial support.

episodes.title: Low Vision Defined: The Impairment Beyond the Correction
episodes.description: The WHO thresholds, the functional impact, and the rehabilitation that medicine alone cannot provide.

episodes.title: The Low Vision Assessment: Beyond the Acuity Chart
episodes.description: Distance, near, contrast, glare, field, and the functional history that defines the goals.

episodes.title: Causes of Low Vision: AMD, Glaucoma, Diabetic Retinopathy
episodes.description: The three leading causes in adults and the very different visual profiles each produces.

episodes.title: Central Vision Loss: The AMD Rehabilitation
episodes.description: The scotoma, the eccentric viewing, and the magnification that restores reading and faces.

episodes.title: Peripheral Vision Loss: The Glaucoma and RP Patient
episodes.description: The tunnel field, the mobility challenge, and the field-expansion and orientation strategies.

episodes.title: Magnification: The Optics and the Power Calculation
episodes.description: Equivalent power, the add, the telescope, and the formula that matches magnification to acuity.

episodes.title: Handheld and Stand Magnifiers: The First Tool
episodes.description: Choosing the type, the illumination, and the working distance that suits each patient.

episodes.title: High-Add Spectacles: The Reading Restoration
episodes.description: The +10 to +20 add, the bifocal and microscope designs, and the reading distance trade-off.

episodes.title: Telescopes: Distance and Near, Galilean and Keplerian
episodes.description: The 4x and 6x systems, the bioptic driving application, and the spotting and trade-off.

episodes.title: Bioptic Driving: The Legal and Clinical Framework
episodes.description: The state laws, the acuity and field criteria, the training, and the independence it restores.

episodes.title: Field Enhancement: Prisms and Reverse Telescopes
episodes.description: The peripheral prism, the field-expanding lens, and the hemianopia rehabilitation role.

episodes.title: Eccentric Viewing Training: The Preferred Retinal Locus
episodes.description: The PRL identification, the training steps, and the practice that builds the habit.

episodes.title: Lighting: The Often-Overlooked Intervention
episodes.description: The lux level, the color temperature, the position, and the glare control that transforms function.

episodes.title: Glare Control: Filters, Tints, and Shields
episodes.description: The 511nm filter, the polarized lens, and the wrap and side-shield that complete the solution.

episodes.title: Assistive Technology: Screen Readers and Magnification Software
episodes.description: The iOS and Android accessibility, the ZoomText and JAWS, and the training that unlocks independence.
